decisions.statement: The pair a renewal is made from is read off the account's page.
An account no credential is read for is answered as holding no credential.
A credential with more life left than the margin is answered without a fetch.
A caller naming no margin is held to the refresh buffer.
A refusal from the token endpoint says whether human re-auth is required.
A token response the wire shape refuses is answered as a malformed response.
A malformed response is not terminal.
A renewed pair is written back to the account's page before that pair is answered.
A pair the page already has counts as written back.
A pair the page has a fresher pair than counts as written back.
The pair answered after a write back that held is read off the page.
A renewed pair that reached no page is answered as the only copy of that pair.
The scopes and the plan and the band are read off the page rather than off the response.
The repository root reaches this module as a parameter.
The clock reaches this module as a door.
The reading of the index and the reader of page bodies reach this module as parameters.
Every line said here goes through a door a caller may replace.
A caller names the account a renewal is made for.
Nothing here throws.
Every failure is answered as an outcome.
Nothing here chooses which account to renew.
No token is written to a log here.
A renewed pair that reached no page is spent by the next renewal.
A write back that held and then reads back absent answers the endpoint's pair instead.

definition: renewing an account's access token off its refresh token
